# Ready-built for the handheld

- **`Apotheca-port.zip`**: the whole thing, for the first install. Unzip it and
  copy `Apotheca.sh` and the `apotheca` folder into the ports folder on the
  SD card.
- **`apotheca`**: the program file by itself, for updating over WiFi (drop it
  on the page's UPDATE APOTHECA button).

Both are built by `scripts/build-handheld.sh` from the source in this
repository, for 64-bit ARM Linux.
